# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Driver::canPostTrip
Summary: Validates whether a driver can publish a new trip.
Algorithm:
  1. If newTrip is null, return false.
  2. If newTrip.departureTime >= newTrip.arrivalTime, return false.
  3. If newTrip.departureDate is null or invalid, return false.
  4. For each existing trip in this.trips:
       a. If newTrip.isTimeConflicting(existingTrip.departureTime, existingTrip.arrivalTime) returns true, return false.
  5. Return true.
Related Features: trips
Related Classes: Trip
Input: newTrip : Trip — the proposed trip to publish
Output: boolean — true if the trip can be published
Pre-condition: newTrip is a valid Trip object with departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime set.
Post-condition: Returns true if all validation rules pass; false otherwise.

Driver::checkStopOverlap
Summary: Checks if two indirect trips share at least one common stop station (case-sensitive).
Algorithm:
  1. If trip1 is null or trip2 is null, return false.
  2. Get stop stations of trip1 via trip1.getStopStations().
  3. Get stop stations of trip2 via trip2.getStopStations().
  4. If either list is empty, return false.
  5. For each station in trip1's list, check if it exists in trip2's list (case-sensitive).
  6. If any match found, return true; otherwise false.
Related Features: trips
Related Classes: Trip
Input: trip1 : Trip, trip2 : Trip
Output: boolean — true if they share at least one stop station
Pre-condition: Both trips belong to this driver.
Post-condition: Returns overlapping status based on stop stations.

Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
```text
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Customer::computeMonthlyRewardPoints
Summary: Computes total reward points earned by this customer for a given month.
Algorithm:
  1. If membershipPackage is null or does not contain Award.POINTS, return 0.
  2. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
  3. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. If booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true:
          i. totalPoints += booking.numberOfSeats * 5
  4. Return totalPoints.
Related Features: bookings, membershipPackage
Related Classes: Booking, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: currentMonth : String — month in "YYYY-MM" format
Output: int — total reward points (0 if ineligible)
Pre-condition: currentMonth is a valid month string.
Post-condition: Returns computed points or 0 if ineligible.

Customer::bookTrip
Summary: Attempts to book a trip for this customer with the given number of seats.
Algorithm:
  1. Create a new Booking object with current date as bookingDate, given trip, given numberOfSeats, and this customer.
  2. Call booking.isBookingEligible().
  3. If eligible, call booking.updateTripSeats(), add booking to this.bookings, and add booking to trip.bookings.
  4. If not eligible, do nothing.
Related Features: bookings, membershipPackage
Related Classes: Booking, Trip
Input: trip : Trip, numberOfSeats : int
Output: void
Pre-condition: trip is not null, numberOfSeats > 0.
Post-condition: If eligible, a new Booking is added to both customer's and trip's booking lists, and trip seats are reduced.

# Operation Specifications
Trip::getBookedSeats
Summary: Returns the total number of seats already booked on this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. Initialize sum = 0.
  2. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. sum += booking.numberOfSeats
  3. Return sum.
Related Features: bookings
Related Classes: Booking
Input: None
Output: int — total booked seats
Pre-condition: bookings list is initialized.
Post-condition: Returns sum of all booked seat counts.

Trip::calculateDiscountedPrice
Summary: Calculates the final price after applying discount reward if applicable.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null or customer.membershipPackage is null, return this.price.
  2. If customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS) is false, return this.price.
  3. Calculate time difference between bookingTime and (departureDate + departureTime).
  4. If difference < 24 hours, return this.price.
  5. discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8.
  6. Return discountedPrice rounded to one decimal place.
Related Features: price, departureDate, departureTime
Related Classes: Customer, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: customer : Customer, bookingTime : String — format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"
Output: double — discounted price (one decimal place) or original price
Pre-condition: price is a valid positive number.
Post-condition: Returns discounted price if conditions met; otherwise original price.

Trip::isTimeConflicting
Summary: Checks if a proposed time interval conflicts with this trip's time interval on the same date.
Algorithm:
  1. If departureDate is null, return false.
  2. Parse departureTime, arrivalTime, newDepartureTime, newArrivalTime.
  3. Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr.
  4. Return true if conflicting, false otherwise.
  5. Note: Adjacent boundaries (one ends exactly when another starts) are allowed (not conflicting).
Related Features: departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime
Related Classes: None
Input: newDepartureTime : String, newArrivalTime : String — time strings in "HH:mm" format
Output: boolean — true if time periods overlap
Pre-condition: This trip has valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime.
Post-condition: Returns overlapping status (exclusive of exact boundaries).

Trip::getStopStations
Summary: Returns a list of all stop station names for this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. Create a new empty list of strings.
  2. For each stop in this.stops:
       a. Add stop.stopStation to the list.
  3. Return the list.
Related Features: stops
Related Classes: Stop
Input: None
Output: List<String> — list of stop station names
Pre-condition: stops list is initialized.
Post-condition: Returns list of station names (may be empty).

Trip::bookSeats
Summary: Reserves the specified number of seats on this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. If num <= 0 or num > numberOfSeats, return false.
  2. numberOfSeats = numberOfSeats - num.
  3. Return true.
Related Features: numberOfSeats
Related Classes: None
Input: num : int — number of seats to book
Output: boolean — true if booking successful, false otherwise
Pre-condition: num > 0
Post-condition: numberOfSeats is reduced by num if successful.

Trip::calculateMonthlyPoints
Summary: Computes reward points for a customer based on bookings in a given month.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null or customer.membershipPackage is null, return 0.
  2. If customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS) is false, return 0.
  3. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
  4. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. If booking.customer equals the given customer AND booking.isInMonth(currentMonth):
          i. totalPoints += booking.numberOfSeats * 5
  5. Return totalPoints.
Related Features: bookings, price
Related Classes: Customer, Booking, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: customer : Customer, currentMonth : String — "YYYY-MM" format
Output: int — total reward points
Pre-condition: customer and currentMonth are valid.
Post-condition: Returns points or 0 if ineligible.

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Trip::getBookedSeats
Summary: Returns the total number of seats already booked on this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. Initialize sum = 0.
  2. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. sum += booking.numberOfSeats
  3. Return sum.
Related Features: bookings
Related Classes: Booking
Input: None
Output: int — total booked seats
Pre-condition: bookings list is initialized.
Post-condition: Returns sum of all booked seat counts.

Trip::calculateDiscountedPrice
Summary: Calculates the final price after applying discount reward if applicable.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null or customer.membershipPackage is null, return this.price.
  2. If customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS) is false, return this.price.
  3. Calculate time difference between bookingTime and (departureDate + departureTime).
  4. If difference < 24 hours, return this.price.
  5. discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8.
  6. Return discountedPrice rounded to one decimal place.
Related Features: price, departureDate, departureTime
Related Classes: Customer, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: customer : Customer, bookingTime : String — format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"
Output: double — discounted price (one decimal place) or original price
Pre-condition: price is a valid positive number.
Post-condition: Returns discounted price if conditions met; otherwise original price.

Trip::isTimeConflicting
Summary: Checks if a proposed time interval conflicts with this trip's time interval on the same date.
Algorithm:
  1. If departureDate is null, return false.
  2. Parse departureTime, arrivalTime, newDepartureTime, newArrivalTime.
  3. Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr.
  4. Return true if conflicting, false otherwise.
  5. Note: Adjacent boundaries (one ends exactly when another starts) are allowed (not conflicting).
Related Features: departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime
Related Classes: None
Input: newDepartureTime : String, newArrivalTime : String — time strings in "HH:mm" format
Output: boolean — true if time periods overlap
Pre-condition: This trip has valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime.
Post-condition: Returns overlapping status (exclusive of exact boundaries).

Trip::getStopStations
Summary: Returns a list of all stop station names for this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. Create a new empty list of strings.
  2. For each stop in this.stops:
       a. Add stop.stopStation to the list.
  3. Return the list.
Related Features: stops
Related Classes: Stop
Input: None
Output: List<String> — list of stop station names
Pre-condition: stops list is initialized.
Post-condition: Returns list of station names (may be empty).

Trip::bookSeats
Summary: Reserves the specified number of seats on this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. If num <= 0 or num > numberOfSeats, return false.
  2. numberOfSeats = numberOfSeats - num.
  3. Return true.
Related Features: numberOfSeats
Related Classes: None
Input: num : int — number of seats to book
Output: boolean — true if booking successful, false otherwise
Pre-condition: num > 0
Post-condition: numberOfSeats is reduced by num if successful.

Trip::calculateMonthlyPoints
Summary: Computes reward points for a customer based on bookings in a given month.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null or customer.membershipPackage is null, return 0.
  2. If customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS) is false, return 0.
  3. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
  4. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. If booking.customer equals the given customer AND booking.isInMonth(currentMonth):
          i. totalPoints += booking.numberOfSeats * 5
  5. Return totalPoints.
Related Features: bookings, price
Related Classes: Customer, Booking, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: customer : Customer, currentMonth : String — "YYYY-MM" format
Output: int — total reward points
Pre-condition: customer and currentMonth are valid.
Post-condition: Returns points or 0 if ineligible.

The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

```text
2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Trip::getBookedSeats
Summary: Returns the total number of seats already booked on this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. Initialize sum = 0.
  2. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. sum += booking.numberOfSeats
  3. Return sum.
Related Features: bookings
Related Classes: Booking
Input: None
Output: int — total booked seats
Pre-condition: bookings list is initialized.
Post-condition: Returns sum of all booked seat counts.

Trip::calculateDiscountedPrice
Summary: Calculates the final price after applying discount reward if applicable.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null or customer.membershipPackage is null, return this.price.
  2. If customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS) is false, return this.price.
  3. Calculate time difference between bookingTime and (departureDate + departureTime).
  4. If difference < 24 hours, return this.price.
  5. discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8.
  6. Return discountedPrice rounded to one decimal place.
Related Features: price, departureDate, departureTime
Related Classes: Customer, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: customer : Customer, bookingTime : String — format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"
Output: double — discounted price (one decimal place) or original price
Pre-condition: price is a valid positive number.
Post-condition: Returns discounted price if conditions met; otherwise original price.

Trip::isTimeConflicting
Summary: Checks if a proposed time interval conflicts with this trip's time interval on the same date.
Algorithm:
  1. If departureDate is null, return false.
  2. Parse departureTime, arrivalTime, newDepartureTime, newArrivalTime.
  3. Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr.
  4. Return true if conflicting, false otherwise.
  5. Note: Adjacent boundaries (one ends exactly when another starts) are allowed (not conflicting).
Related Features: departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime
Related Classes: None
Input: newDepartureTime : String, newArrivalTime : String — time strings in "HH:mm" format
Output: boolean — true if time periods overlap
Pre-condition: This trip has valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime.
Post-condition: Returns overlapping status (exclusive of exact boundaries).

Trip::getStopStations
Summary: Returns a list of all stop station names for this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. Create a new empty list of strings.
  2. For each stop in this.stops:
       a. Add stop.stopStation to the list.
  3. Return the list.
Related Features: stops
Related Classes: Stop
Input: None
Output: List<String> — list of stop station names
Pre-condition: stops list is initialized.
Post-condition: Returns list of station names (may be empty).

Trip::bookSeats
Summary: Reserves the specified number of seats on this trip.
Algorithm:
  1. If num <= 0 or num > numberOfSeats, return false.
  2. numberOfSeats = numberOfSeats - num.
  3. Return true.
Related Features: numberOfSeats
Related Classes: None
Input: num : int — number of seats to book
Output: boolean — true if booking successful, false otherwise
Pre-condition: num > 0
Post-condition: numberOfSeats is reduced by num if successful.

Trip::calculateMonthlyPoints
Summary: Computes reward points for a customer based on bookings in a given month.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null or customer.membershipPackage is null, return 0.
  2. If customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS) is false, return 0.
  3. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
  4. For each booking in this.bookings:
       a. If booking.customer equals the given customer AND booking.isInMonth(currentMonth):
          i. totalPoints += booking.numberOfSeats * 5
  5. Return totalPoints.
Related Features: bookings
Related Classes: Customer, Booking, MembershipPackage, Award
Input: customer : Customer, currentMonth : String — "YYYY-MM" format
Output: int — total reward points
Pre-condition: customer and currentMonth are valid.
Post-condition: Returns points or 0 if ineligible.

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

# Operation Specifications
Booking::isBookingEligible
Summary: Determines whether a customer can book seats on this trip according to the business rules.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null, trip is null, or bookingDate is null, return false.
  2. If numberOfSeats <= 0 or numberOfSeats > trip.getAvailableSeats(), return false.
  3. If this booking overlaps with any other booking of the same customer on the same day (via overlapsWith), return false.
  4. If the booking date/time is not strictly more than 2 hours before trip departure, return false.
  5. If all checks pass, return true.
Related Features: numberOfSeats, customer, trip, bookingDate, trip.numberOfSeats, trip.departureDate, trip.departureTime
Related Classes: Customer, Trip
Input: None (uses the attributes of the Booking instance)
Output: boolean — true if eligible, false otherwise
Pre-condition: The Booking object must have its attributes (customer, trip, bookingDate, numberOfSeats) set.
Post-condition: Returns true only if all eligibility conditions are met; otherwise false.

Booking::updateTripSeats
Summary: Reduces the trip's available seats by the number of booked seats.
Algorithm:
  1. Call trip.bookSeats(this.numberOfSeats).
Related Features: trip, numberOfSeats
Related Classes: Trip
Input: None
Output: void
Pre-condition: numberOfSeats > 0 and trip has enough available seats.
Post-condition: trip's numberOfSeats is reduced by numberOfSeats.

Booking::isInMonth
Summary: Checks whether the booking's date falls within the specified month (format "YYYY-MM").
Algorithm:
  1. Extract year and month from bookingDate.
  2. Compare with the given month string (format "YYYY-MM").
  3. Return true if they match, false otherwise.
Related Features: bookingDate
Related Classes: None
Input: month : String — month in "YYYY-MM" format
Output: boolean — true if bookingDate is in that month
Pre-condition: bookingDate is a valid date; month is a non-null string in "YYYY-MM" format.
Post-condition: Returns true if the booking's year and month match the input.

Booking::overlapsWith
Summary: Checks if this booking's trip time overlaps with the given trip's time on the same day.
Algorithm:
  1. If either trip is null, return false.
  2. Compare departureDate of both trips. If not same date, return false.
  3. Parse departureTime and arrivalTime of both trips.
  4. Two time intervals [dep1, arr1] and [dep2, arr2] overlap if dep1 < arr2 AND dep2 < arr1.
  5. Return true if overlapping, false otherwise.
Related Features: trip (departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime)
Related Classes: Trip
Input: trip : Trip — the trip to compare against
Output: boolean — true if time periods overlap on the same day
Pre-condition: Both trips have valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime.
Post-condition: Returns overlapping status as boolean.

# Operation Specifications
Booking::isBookingEligible
Summary: Determines whether a customer can book seats on this trip according to the business rules.
Algorithm:
  1. If customer is null, trip is null, or bookingDate is null, return false.
  2. If numberOfSeats <= 0 or numberOfSeats > trip.getAvailableSeats(), return false.
  3. If this booking overlaps with any other booking of the same customer on the same day (via overlapsWith), return false.
  4. If the booking date/time is not strictly more than 2 hours before trip departure, return false.
  5. If all checks pass, return true.
Related Features: numberOfSeats, customer, trip, bookingDate, trip.numberOfSeats, trip.departureDate, trip.departureTime
Related Classes: Customer, Trip
Input: None (uses the attributes of the Booking instance)
Output: boolean — true if eligible, false otherwise
Pre-condition: The Booking object must have its attributes (customer, trip, bookingDate, numberOfSeats) set.
Post-condition: Returns true only if all eligibility conditions are met; otherwise false.

Booking::updateTripSeats
Summary: Reduces the trip's available seats by the number of booked seats.
Algorithm:
  1. Call trip.bookSeats(this.numberOfSeats).
Related Features: trip, numberOfSeats
Related Classes: Trip
Input: None
Output: void
Pre-condition: numberOfSeats > 0 and trip has enough available seats.
Post-condition: trip's numberOfSeats is reduced by numberOfSeats.

Booking::isInMonth
Summary: Checks whether the booking's date falls within the specified month (format "YYYY-MM").
Algorithm:
  1. Extract year and month from bookingDate.
  2. Compare with the given month string (format "YYYY-MM").
  3. Return true if they match, false otherwise.
Related Features: bookingDate
Related Classes: None
Input: month : String — month in "YYYY-MM" format
Output: boolean — true if bookingDate is in that month
Pre-condition: bookingDate is a valid date; month is a non-null string in "YYYY-MM" format.
Post-condition: Returns true if the booking's year and month match the input.

Booking::overlapsWith
Summary: Checks if this booking's trip time overlaps with the given trip's time on the same day.
Algorithm:
  1. If either trip is null, return false.
  2. Compare departureDate of both trips. If not same date, return false.
  3. Parse departureTime and arrivalTime of both trips.
  4. Two time intervals [dep1, arr1] and [dep2, arr2] overlap if dep1 < arr2 AND dep2 < arr1.
  5. Return true if overlapping, false otherwise.
Related Features: trip (departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime)
Related Classes: Trip
Input: trip : Trip — the trip to compare against
Output: boolean — true if time periods overlap on the same day
Pre-condition: Both trips have valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime.
Post-condition: Returns overlapping status as boolean.

# Requirement
```text
Online Rideshare System (ORS) manages shared road trips between drivers and customers. Every user is identified by an id and also stores an email address and a phone number so that the platform can distinguish and contact the user.

A driver can publish trips. A trip records a departure station, an arrival station, the number of available seats, a departure date, a departure time, an arrival time, and a price. Trips can be direct or indirect. An indirect trip contains one or more stops, and each stop stores the name of its stop station.

A customer can create bookings for trips. A booking records the requested number of seats, the booking date, the related customer, and the related trip. A booking is valid only when the trip exists, enough seats are still available, the customer has no overlapping booking on the same day, and the booking is made more than two hours before the trip departure time. When a booking is accepted, the trip seat inventory must be reduced accordingly.

Customers may subscribe to a membership package. A membership package stores one or more rewards, and each reward is one of cashback, discounts, or points. A customer with a discount reward receives a 20 percent discount only when the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. A customer with a points reward earns 5 points per booked seat for bookings created within the requested month.

A driver may publish a new trip only when the proposed trip has a valid time window and does not overlap with the driver’s existing trips. Two indirect trips posted by the same driver are considered overlapping by stops when they share at least one stop station, and stop-name comparison is case-sensitive.
Functional requirement:
1. Validate Booking Eligibility.
The system shall determine whether a customer can book seats on a trip. The trip must exist, the trip must still have enough available seats, the requested seats must not exceed the remaining seats, and the customer must not already hold another booking whose trip time overlaps on the same day. The booking time must be strictly earlier than the departure time by more than two hours, so a booking made exactly two hours before departure is rejected. When the booking is accepted, the trip seat count shall be reduced. Invalid inputs such as a null customer, null trip, or null booking date shall return `false`.

2. Calculate Discounted Trip Price.
The system shall calculate the final price of a booking after reward evaluation. A fixed 20 percent discount applies only when the customer owns a membership package containing the `DISCOUNTS` award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place. When the customer, membership package, booking time, or reward condition is invalid or missing, the original trip price shall be returned.

3. Check Stop Overlap for Indirect Trips.
The system shall determine whether two indirect trips posted by the same driver share at least one common stop station. The comparison is case-sensitive. If either trip is null or one of the stop collections is empty, the result shall be `false`.

4. Compute Monthly Reward Points.
The system shall compute the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the `POINTS` award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month shall be counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards shall return `0`.

5. Validate Trip Posting Feasibility.
The system shall validate whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and the departure time must be earlier than the arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs shall return `false`.
```

```java
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Validates whether a driver can publish a new trip. The proposed trip must exist, its departure time and arrival time must be valid, and departure time must be earlier than arrival time. The new trip must not overlap with any existing trip of the driver. Completely identical time periods are conflicts, while adjacent boundaries where one trip ends exactly when another starts are allowed. Invalid inputs return false.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If newtrip is null, return false.
   *   2. If newtrip.departureDate is null, newtrip.departureTime is null, or newtrip.arrivalTime is null, return false.
   *   3. If newtrip.departureTime is not strictly earlier than newtrip.arrivalTime, return false.
   *   4. For each existing trip in this.trips:
   *        a. If newtrip.isTimeConflicting(existingTrip.departureTime, existingTrip.arrivalTime) returns true, return false.
   *   5. Return true.
   * Related Features: trips
   * Related Classes: Trip
   * Input: newtrip : Trip — the proposed trip to publish.
   * Output: boolean — true if the trip can be published.
   * Pre-condition: Driver object is initialized with existing trips list.
   * Post-condition: Returns whether the trip posting is feasible.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
```
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean canPostTrip(final Trip newtrip)
  {
    if (newtrip == null) {
      return false;
    }
    if (newtrip.getDepartureDate() == null || newtrip.getDepartureTime() == null || newtrip.getArrivalTime() == null) {
      return false;
    }
    if (!(newtrip.getDepartureTime().compareTo(newtrip.getArrivalTime()) < 0)) {
      return false;
    }
    for (Trip existingTrip : this.getTrips()) {
      if (newtrip.isTimeConflicting(existingTrip.getDepartureTime(), existingTrip.getArrivalTime())) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

```java
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime
    // If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price
    try {
      // Parse departure date and time
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateTimeStr = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").format(this.departureDate) + " " + this.departureTime;
      Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    // Round to one decimal place
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
  }
```

```java
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime
    // If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price
    try {
      // Parse departure date and time
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateTimeStr = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").format(this.departureDate) + " " + this.departureTime;
      Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    // Round to one decimal place
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
  }
```

```java
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime
    // If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price
    try {
      // Parse departure date and time
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateTimeStr = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").format(this.departureDate) + " " + this.departureTime;
      Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    // Round to one decimal place
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
  }
```

```java
   * Summary: Calculates the final price of a booking after applying a 20% discount if the customer has a membership package containing the DISCOUNTS award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure.   public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {

   * Summary: Checks if a proposed time interval conflicts with this trip's time interval on the same date.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If departureDate is null, return false.
   *   2. Parse departureTime, arrivalTime, newDepartureTime, newArrivalTime.

  public boolean isTimeConflicting(final String newDepartureTime, final String newArrivalTime)
  {
    if (this.departureDate == null) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
      Date dep = timeFormat.parse(this.departureTime);
      Date arr = timeFormat.parse(this.arrivalTime);
      Date newDep = timeFormat.parse(newDepartureTime);
      Date newArr = timeFormat.parse(newArrivalTime);
      // Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr
      // Adjacent boundaries (one ends exactly when another starts) are allowed (not conflicting)
      // So we use strict less-than (before) comparison
      if (dep.before(newArr) && newDep.before(arr)) {
        return true;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  }
```

```java
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return getPrice();

      SimpleDateFormat dateTimeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateStr = dateFormat.format(getDepartureDate());
      String departureDateTimeStr = departureDateStr + " " + getDepartureTime();
      Date departureDateTime = dateTimeFormat.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = dateTimeFormat.parse(bookingTime);
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return getPrice();
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    double discountedPrice = getPrice() * 0.8;
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
  }
```

```java
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime
    // If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price
    try {
      // Parse departure date and time
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateTimeStr = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd").format(this.departureDate) + " " + this.departureTime;
      Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    // Round to one decimal place
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
  }
```

```java
      SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
      SimpleDateFormat dateTimeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateStr = dateFormat.format(this.departureDate);
      String departureDateTimeStr = departureDateStr + " " + this.departureTime;
      Date departureDateTime = dateTimeFormat.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = dateTimeFormat.parse(bookingTime);
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Computes the reward points earned by a customer during a given month. Only customers whose membership package contains the POINTS award are eligible. Only bookings whose booking date falls inside the requested month are counted. Each booked seat contributes 5 points. Invalid inputs, missing membership packages, or unsupported rewards return 0.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If customer is null, membershipPackage is null, or currentMonth is null, return 0.
   *   2. Call customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS). If false, return 0.
   *   3. Initialize totalPoints = 0.
   *   4. For each booking in customer.bookings:
   *        a. If booking.trip == this and booking.isInMonth(currentMonth) is true:
   *           totalPoints += booking.numberOfSeats * 5.
   *   5. Return totalPoints.
   * Related Features: bookings, customer, membershipPackage
   * Related Classes: Customer, Booking, MembershipPackage, Award
   * Input: customer : Customer — the customer to compute points for; currentMonth : String — the month in format "YYYY-MM".
   * Output: int — the total reward points earned.
   * Pre-condition: Customer and trip objects are initialized.
   * Post-condition: Returns the computed points or 0.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public int calculateMonthlyPoints(final Customer customer, final String currentMonth)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || currentMonth == null) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.POINTS)) {
      return 0;
    }
    int totalPoints = 0;
    for (Booking booking : customer.getBookings()) {
      if (booking.getTrip() == this && booking.isInMonth(currentMonth)) {
        totalPoints += booking.getNumberOfSeats() * 5;
      }
    }
    return totalPoints;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * Summary: Checks if a proposed time interval conflicts with this trip's time interval on the same date.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If departureDate is null, return false.
   *   2. Parse departureTime, arrivalTime, newDepartureTime, newArrivalTime.
   *   3. Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr.
   *   4. Return true if conflicting, false otherwise.
   *   5. Note: Adjacent boundaries (one ends exactly when another starts) are allowed (not conflicting).
   * Related Features: departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime
   * Related Classes: None
   * Input: newDepartureTime : String, newArrivalTime : String — time strings in "HH:mm" format
   * Output: boolean — true if time periods overlap
   * Pre-condition: This trip has valid departureDate, departureTime, arrivalTime.
   * Post-condition: Returns overlapping status (exclusive of exact boundaries).
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public boolean isTimeConflicting(final String newDepartureTime, final String newArrivalTime)
  {
    if (this.departureDate == null) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
      Date dep = timeFormat.parse(this.departureTime);
      Date arr = timeFormat.parse(this.arrivalTime);
      Date newDep = timeFormat.parse(newDepartureTime);
      Date newArr = timeFormat.parse(newArrivalTime);
      // Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr
      // Adjacent boundaries (one ends exactly when another starts) are allowed (not conflicting)
      // So we use strict less-than (before) comparison
      if (dep.before(newArr) && newDep.before(arr)) {
        return true;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  }
```

```java
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return this.price;

    // If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price

      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);

      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    // Round to one decimal place
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
```

```java
   * Summary: Calculates the final price of a booking after applying a 20% discount if the customer has a membership package containing the DISCOUNTS award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. If conditions are not met or inputs are invalid, returns the original trip price. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If customer is null, membershipPackage is null, or bookingTime is null, return this.price.
   *   2. Call customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS). If false, return this.price.
   *   3. Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime. If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price.
   *   4. Calculate discounted price = this.price * 0.8.

   * Related Features: price, departureDate, departureTime, customer, membershipPackage
   * Related Classes: Customer, MembershipPackage, Award
   * Input: customer : Customer — the customer requesting the booking; bookingTime : String — the booking date and time in a parseable format.
   * Output: double — the discounted price with one decimal place, or the original price.
   * Pre-condition: this trip object is initialized with price and departure time.
   * Post-condition: Returns the final price after discount evaluation.

   * @generated NOT

  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || customer.getMembershipPackage() == null || bookingTime == null) {
```
```java
      return getPrice();
    }
    if (!customer.getMembershipPackage().hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    try {
      SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
      SimpleDateFormat dateTimeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      String departureDateStr = dateFormat.format(getDepartureDate());
      String departureDateTimeStr = departureDateStr + " " + getDepartureTime();
      Date departureDateTime = dateTimeFormat.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = dateTimeFormat.parse(bookingTime);
      long diffInMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long diffInHours = diffInMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      if (diffInHours < 24) {
        return getPrice();
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    double discountedPrice = getPrice() * 0.8;
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10) / 10.0;
```

```java
public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
{
    // 1. If customer is null, membershipPackage is null, or bookingTime is null, return this.price.
    if (customer == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // 2. Call customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS). If false, return this.price.
    if (!membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // 3. Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime.
    //    If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price.
    try {
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      // Combine departureDate and departureTime
      SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
      String dateStr = dateFormat.format(this.departureDate);
      String departureDateTimeStr = dateStr + " " + this.departureTime;
      Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      
      long diffMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long twentyFourHoursMillis = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L;
      if (diffMillis < twentyFourHoursMillis) {
        return this.price;
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return this.price;
    }
    // 4. Calculate discounted price = this.price * 0.8
    double discountedPrice = this.price * 0.8;
    // 5. Return the result rounded to one decimal place.
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10.0) / 10.0;
}
```

```java
  public int calculateMonthlyPoints(final Customer customer, final String currentMonth)
  {
    if (customer == null || currentMonth == null) {
      return 0;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (!membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS)) {
      return 0;
    }
    int totalPoints = 0;
    for (Booking booking : customer.getBookings()) {
      if (booking.getTrip() == this && booking.isInMonth(currentMonth)) {
        totalPoints += booking.getNumberOfSeats() * 5;
      }
    }
    return totalPoints;
  }
```

```java
  public boolean isTimeConflicting(final String newDepartureTime, final String newArrivalTime)
  {
    if (getDepartureDate() == null) {
      return false;
    }
    try {
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
      Date dep = sdf.parse(getDepartureTime());
      Date arr = sdf.parse(getArrivalTime());
      Date newDep = sdf.parse(newDepartureTime);
      Date newArr = sdf.parse(newArrivalTime);
      
      // Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr
      // Note: Adjacent boundaries are not conflicting (strict less than)
      if (dep.getTime() < newArr.getTime() && newDep.getTime() < arr.getTime()) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return false;
    }
  }
```

```java
  /**
```
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Calculates the final price of a booking after applying a 20% discount if the customer has a membership package containing the DISCOUNTS award and the booking is made at least 24 hours before departure. If conditions are not met or inputs are invalid, returns the original trip price. The returned amount shall keep one decimal place.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If customer is null, membershipPackage is null, or bookingTime is null, return this.price.
   *   2. Call customer.membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS). If false, return this.price.
   *   3. Calculate the difference between departure time and bookingTime. If the booking is not made at least 24 hours before departure, return this.price.
   *   4. Calculate discounted price = this.price * 0.8.
   *   5. Return the result rounded to one decimal place.
   * Related Features: price, departureDate, departureTime, customer, membershipPackage
   * Related Classes: Customer, MembershipPackage, Award
   * Input: customer : Customer — the customer requesting the booking; bookingTime : String — the booking date and time in a parseable format.
   * Output: double — the discounted price with one decimal place, or the original price.
   * Pre-condition: this trip object is initialized with price and departure time.
   * Post-condition: Returns the final price after discount evaluation.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public double calculateDiscountedPrice(final Customer customer, final String bookingTime)
  {
    if (customer == null || bookingTime == null) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    if (!membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.DISCOUNTS)) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    try {
      SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
      SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
      String dateStr = dateFormat.format(getDepartureDate());
      String departureDateTimeStr = dateStr + " " + getDepartureTime();
      Date departureDateTime = sdf.parse(departureDateTimeStr);
      Date bookingDateTime = sdf.parse(bookingTime);
      
      long diffMillis = departureDateTime.getTime() - bookingDateTime.getTime();
      long twentyFourHoursMillis = 24L * 60L * 60L * 1000L;
      if (diffMillis < twentyFourHoursMillis) {
        return getPrice();
      }
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return getPrice();
    }
    double discountedPrice = getPrice() * 0.8;
    return Math.round(discountedPrice * 10.0) / 10.0;
  }

   *           totalPoints += booking.numberOfSeats * 5.

   * @generated NOT

  public int calculateMonthlyPoints(final Customer customer, final String currentMonth)
  {
    if (customer == null || currentMonth == null) {
      return 0;
    }
    MembershipPackage membershipPackage = customer.getMembershipPackage();
    if (membershipPackage == null) {
      return 0;
    }
    if (!membershipPackage.hasAward(Award.POINTS)) {
      return 0;
    }
    int totalPoints = 0;
    for (Booking booking : customer.getBookings()) {
      if (booking.getTrip() == this && booking.isInMonth(currentMonth)) {

      }
    }
    return totalPoints;

      Date newDep = sdf.parse(newDepartureTime);
      Date newArr = sdf.parse(newArrivalTime);
      
      // Two intervals [dep, arr] and [newDep, newArr] conflict if dep < newArr AND newDep < arr
      // Adjacent boundaries are allowed (not conflicting), so use strict less than
      if (dep.getTime() < newArr.getTime() && newDep.getTime() < arr.getTime()) {
        return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (Exception e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

```java
public boolean isBookingEligible()
{
    // 1. If this.customer is null or this.trip is null or this.bookingDate is null, return false.
    if (customer == null || trip == null || bookingDate == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // 2. If this.trip.bookSeats(this.numberOfSeats) returns false, return false.
    if (!trip.bookSeats(numberOfSeats)) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // 3. If this.numberOfSeats <= 0 or this.numberOfSeats > this.trip.numberOfSeats, return false.
    if (numberOfSeats <= 0 || numberOfSeats > trip.getNumberOfSeats()) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // 4. For each booking in this.customer.bookings:
    for (Booking booking : customer.getBookings()) {
        // a. If booking.trip.isTimeConflicting(this.trip.departureTime, this.trip.arrivalTime) returns true, return false.
        if (booking.getTrip() != null && booking.getTrip().isTimeConflicting(trip.getDepartureTime(), trip.getArrivalTime())) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // 5. Calculate time difference between this.trip.departureTime and current time.
    // If difference is less than or equal to 2 hours, return false.
    // Need to parse departureTime string and compare with current time
    String depTime = trip.getDepartureTime();
    // Parse the departureTime as HH:mm and compare with current time
    // For simplicity, we'll parse the time and check if it's more than 2 hours from now
    try {
        SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
        Date departureTimeParsed = sdf.parse(depTime);
        Date now = new Date();
        // We need to compare just the time portion, or use full datetime
        // Actually, the departureTime is just time, so let's compare with current time of day
        String nowTimeStr = sdf.format(now);
        Date nowTime = sdf.parse(nowTimeStr);
        long diff = departureTimeParsed.getTime() - nowTime.getTime();
        if (diff <= 0 || diff <= 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000) {

        }

        return false;
    }

}
```

```java
public boolean overlapsWith(final Trip trip) {
    if (this.trip == null || trip == null) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Compare departureDate
    Date thisDate = this.trip.getDepartureDate();
    Date otherDate = trip.getDepartureDate();
    
    SimpleDateFormat sdf = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
    String thisDateStr = sdf.format(thisDate);
    String otherDateStr = sdf.format(otherDate);
    
    if (!thisDateStr.equals(otherDateStr)) {
        return false;
    }
    
    // Parse times
    SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
    Date dep1 = timeFormat.parse(this.trip.getDepartureTime());
    Date arr1 = timeFormat.parse(this.trip.getArrivalTime());
    Date dep2 = timeFormat.parse(trip.getDepartureTime());
    Date arr2 = timeFormat.parse(trip.getArrivalTime());
    
    // Overlap check: dep1 < arr2 AND dep2 < arr1
    return dep1.before(arr2) && dep2.before(arr1);
}
```

```java
    try {
        Date depDate = trip.getDepartureDate();
        String depTime = trip.getDepartureTime();
        SimpleDateFormat dateFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd");
        SimpleDateFormat dateTimeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm");
```

      if (!thisDateStr.equals(otherDateStr)) {
        return false;
      }

      SimpleDateFormat timeFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm");
      Date dep1 = timeFormat.parse(getTrip().getDepartureTime());

      Date dep2 = timeFormat.parse(trip.getDepartureTime());
      Date arr2 = timeFormat.parse(trip.getArrivalTime());

      // 5. Return true if overlapping, false otherwise.
      return dep1.before(arr2) && dep2.before(arr1);
    } catch (ParseException e) {
      return false;
    }
